In January 2024, nineteen of us said "for american families." That was our most repeated phrase, peaking on 2024-01-31. Eighteen of us said "relief for american families and workers," and eighteen "for american families and workers act," and eighteen "tax relief for american families and" — all peaking the same day, the last of the month. Fifteen of us said "the tax relief for american families." Jodey C. Arrington first said several of these on 2024-01-16; the words "for american families" reach back to Mike Crapo on 2013-01-08.

On 2024-01-18, twelve of us said "the colorado supreme," first said by Thom Tillis on 2023-12-19, and twelve of us said "our southern border." Twelve of us said "ways and means," peaking 2024-01-31. We converged, and the ledger holds when and how many.
